_note: Recent news on the home page. Items sort automatically by the sort date (YYYY-MM-DD), newest first. The date field is what visitors see. kind is one of article, event, report, award, position, book, blog (sets the small icon and label).

items.title: CADRE at the Earth Institute coffee morning
items.text: I introduced CADRE at the UCD Earth Institute’s coffee morning for its new Strategic Interdisciplinary Award projects, alongside BRIDGE and LEAF.

items.title: New article in *Environmental Research Letters*
items.text: Regional El Niño patterns shape how wheat-flour prices respond to floods, droughts, and storms.

items.title: New article in *Civil Wars*
items.text: With Kasia Houghton, on how mediators who also fund rebel groups shape conflict resolution.

items.title: Two papers at APSA 2026
items.text: I presented work on climate law adoption (with Tahlia Mullen) and rare earths and armed conflict (with Päivi Lujala).

items.title: New article in *Humanities and Social Sciences Communications*
items.text: Floods and storms raise battle events, and food price instability amplifies the effect.

items.title: CADRE named an Earth Institute Strategic Priority
items.text: CADRE won a UCD Earth Institute Strategic Interdisciplinary Award and was named a Strategic Priority for 2026–27.

items.title: MEND policy brief: *Mediation in 2025*
items.text: With Mateja Peter, Kasia Houghton, and Sanja Badanjak, I track mediation across overlapping conflict systems in 2025 using MEND data.

items.title: Speaking at PeaceRep’s closing conference
items.text: I spoke on the Mediation Futures and PeaceTech panel at “Time to Make a Change” in Edinburgh, marking five years of PeaceRep research.

items.title: Presenting at the CCEW Symposium, Berlin
items.text: I’m presenting at the Center for Crisis Early Warning symposium, “Conflict Early Warning in Times of Power Competition: Limits and Challenges.”

items.title: New article in *Global Environmental Politics*
items.text: A difference-in-differences study of how hydropower development shapes conflict.

items.title: WG1 Workshop on Climate Change, Natural Resources, and Conflict, Milan
items.text: I presented my paper with Päivi Lujala at this COST Action Peace Research Community Europe workshop at the Politecnico di Milano.

items.title: Presenting at SPSA, New Orleans
items.text: The Southern Political Science Association annual meeting, including its Conference-within-a-Conference on crises and disasters.

items.title: SPIRe Early Career Researcher Forum talk
items.text: I spoke at UCD SPIRe’s Early Career Researcher Forum on navigating the current academic job market.

items.title: SPIRe Seminar, University College Dublin
items.text: I presented “From Disaster to Dispute in the DRC: Climate’s Role in Resource Wars.”

items.title: Presenting at PECE, Vancouver
items.text: The Political Economy of Climate and Environment conference, at Simon Fraser University ahead of APSA.

items.title: New article in *Climate Policy*
items.text: With Tofigh Maboudi, on when climate policies are adopted and how timing shapes adaptive resilience.

items.title: New article in *Political Research Quarterly*
items.text: With Tofigh Maboudi, on whether constitutional rights shape climate litigation outcomes.

items.title: New article in the *Journal of Peace Research*
items.text: With Santiago Sosa and Molly Melin, on economic provisions in peace agreements and the durability of peace.

items.title: New article in *npj Climate Action*
items.text: Isolating the climate adaptation measures that matter in New England.

items.title: LSE Sustainable Social Policy Workshop
items.text: The inaugural workshop of LSE’s Sustainable Social Policy cluster.

items.title: New article in the *Review of International Political Economy*
items.text: From garments to grievances: urban growth and economic shocks in rapidly industrialising economies.

items.title: Poster at PolMeth Europe, LSE
items.text: LSE Methodology recorded my poster walkthrough on the geography of conflict mediation.

items.title: New article in *Environmental Policy and Governance*
items.text: With Tofigh Maboudi, on vulnerability, climate laws, and adaptation in the Middle East and North Africa.

items.title: Anthropocene lecture, University of Basel
items.text: “Anthropocene Mobilities: Navigating the Complexities of Climate-Induced Migration,” in the Institute for European Global Studies lecture series.

items.title: Presenting at CARMA 2024, Valencia
items.text: The 6th International Conference on Advanced Research Methods and Analytics.

items.title: CEEISA-ISA Joint Conference, Rijeka
items.text: The joint CEEISA and International Studies Association conference, “Knowing the Global-Local.”

items.title: Joining PeaceRep as a postdoctoral fellow
items.text: I started as a Postdoctoral Research Fellow with PeaceRep at the University of St Andrews.

items.title: Connected_Politics Lab seminar on climate finance
items.text: With Andreas Hoepner and Diego P. Guisande, on how disasters, corporate lobbying, and climate policy shape market responses.

items.title: Workshop on EU climate policy and politics, UCD
items.text: Katelyn Nutley and I presented our work on environmental protest and climate policy at “From Promise to Practice: Decoding EU Climate Policy and Politics.”

items.title: Joining UCD as Assistant Professor and Ad Astra Fellow
items.text: I joined UCD’s School of Politics and International Relations as Assistant Professor in Environmental Politics and Ad Astra Fellow.

items.title: Research Fellow, Centre for Global Law and Governance
items.text: I joined the University of St Andrews Centre for Global Law and Governance as a Research Fellow.

items.title: Book contract with Cambridge University Press
items.text: The Press Syndicate approved my book, *The Effects of Climate Change We Don’t Count: Migration, Cities, and Hidden Instability*.

items.title: Visiting Fellow, University of Basel
items.text: I joined the Institute for European Global Studies at the University of Basel as a Visiting Fellow, working on hydropower development and conflict.

items.title: Ad Astra Fellow Research Award, UCD
items.text: My UCD Ad Astra Fellowship in Environmental Politics began, with a five-year research award.

items.title: PeaceRep report: *Conflict in a Warming World*
items.text: How climate shocks shape rebel demands for water, land, and resources, and whether peace agreements respond.

items.title: PeaceRep report: *Semi-Automated Coding for Conflict Mediation Research*
items.text: How I built the semi-automated pipeline behind the MEND database, in PeaceRep’s Peace Analytics Series.

items.title: MEND policy brief: *Current Trends in Mediation*
items.text: Key findings from MEND on crowded mediation environments, with Mateja Peter, Kasia Houghton, and Sanja Badanjak.

items.title: Student blog: *Implementation Over Urgency*
items.text: What 2,170 parliamentary speeches reveal about climate law in Ireland, a Connected_Politics Lab project I designed and supervised.

items.title: Interactive: *Bridging the Distance*
items.text: An interactive data story on geography and conflict mediation, with web and visualizations by Tomas Vancisin.

items.title: IOM blog: *Stitching a Sustainable Future*
items.text: Policy for youth, migration, and climate change in Bangladesh’s garment industry, for IOM UN Migration.

items.title: Case summary: *Montenegro v. Ashcroft*
items.text: A case summary for the Earth Refuge Legal Database.

items.title: Op-ed: *Rising Tides and Sudden Surprises*
items.text: The two faces of climate displacement, on Medium.
